# Intervyo AI-Powered Mock Interview Platform

Intervyo is an advanced AI-powered mock interview and technical practice platform designed to help software engineers, product managers, and professionals master their job interviews.

## Core Features
- **AI Mock Interviews**: Realistic technical and behavioral mock interviews with real-time AI feedback.
- **Speech & Emotion Analysis**: Live video & audio sentiment analysis powered by TensorFlow.js and face-api.js.
- **Code Practice Lab**: Integrated Monaco code editor for live coding problems with instant automated evaluation.
- **Detailed Analytics**: Comprehensive scoring reports on communication clarity, technical depth, and pacing.
